hypothesis: After the first 15 minutes of reaction to a Binance USDS-M perpetual listing announcement, the announced asset's pre-existing Binance spot market gives back more than 30 bps gross in excess of BTCUSDT over the following 6 hours, measured from the open of the first 1-minute bar at least 15 minutes and 60 seconds after the official publication timestamp, because the initial reaction is dominated by momentum buyers who overshoot.
economic_reason: The first reaction to a listing headline is bought by the fastest, least informed participants (bots on keywords, retail on push notifications). If they overshoot, the overshoot is sold back by holders and market makers once the headline is digested. The payer is the momentum buyer of the first quarter hour; the seller after 15 minutes earns the reversal, if there is one.

entry_rule.price: open of the first 1m bar whose open_time >= entry time (tolerance 2 min, else excluded)

cost_model.notes: Binance spot VIP0 published 10/10 bps per side; round trip 28 bps; wall 3x = 84 bps

validation_window.nature: historical first look on the frozen official event tape (reports/first_look/event_reaction_v1_FREEZE.json); one look, then forward seal or death

declustering_rule.note: cluster-robust standard error by UTC publication day: several assets announced together are one cluster

notes: RESEARCH_ONLY. First-look hypothesis H2 of reports/first_look/event_reaction_v1_PREREG.md. Short on spot is not executable without borrow: tradable_share is expected to fail on spot-only events; a positive result on spot can only be a SELL signal for holders, and the verdict says so.
